name: Graph Layout Benchmark Collection
description: We  built  a  website  to  help  graph  drawing  researchers  find benchmark datasets to use for evaluating graph layout algorithms. Find it here: https://visdunneright.github.io/gdbenchmarksets/. The datasets and supplemental materials are also available at https://osf.io/j7ucv/
evaluation_method: human_eval / aesthetic metrics (edge crossings, stress, angular resolution, edge-length variance)
general_score_metric: varies — aesthetic metrics (e.g., edge crossings, stress, angular resolution)
reputation: A curated, niche collection widely used by graph-drawing and visualization researchers as a convenient source of benchmark graphs, but not a mainstream ML benchmark.
notes: Collection of datasets rather than a single standardized benchmark; evaluation protocols and metrics vary by study. Not directly comparable to typical ML benchmarks; primarily non-LLM and non-deep-learning in orientation.
